subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix for this issue be a Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute repair, a shared inbound non-direct session fallback, or deferred until a live Telegram restart repro is captured?
rationale: Current source supports a real gap, but the narrow Telegram fix and the broader shared fallback have different compatibility and ownership risk, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary alone.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run the live plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram's plain group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the repro points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Use the shared non-direct delivery-context fallback as the canonical fix, but require compatibility review across channel plugins before merge.

options.title: Defer for more data
options.body: Keep the issue open as needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter can capture current-main restart evidence.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run the live plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram's plain group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the repro points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the shared session recorder boundary that steipete introduced and maintained.
